title: tunnelmind:data_model:v1 — structured query artifact
description: profile_artifacts/queries/{query_sha256}.json: the structured query an assessment or golden question names by query_sha256 — metric, dimensions, filters, time range. No field admits free text (ATAP §7.6): metric and dimensions are field_refs, a filter value is only a number, a boolean or an opaque token (no `@`, no whitespace), and every object sets additionalProperties:false. A question in natural language, an email or a name typed with spaces has nowhere to go.

field_ref.description: Same pattern as witness-events.schema.json field_ref: dotted lower-case identifiers only.

scalar.description: A filter value: a number, a boolean, or an opaque token (an enum member such as `failure` or `eap-tls` is an opaque token). Same token pattern as witness-events.schema.json opaque_id: no `@`, no whitespace.
